title: 第25章 誓师第26章 渡河
content_zh:
南宫燕走的那天，肖琪没有回头。
他走进中军大帐，议事，调兵，布防，像什么都没发生过。
但所有人都看得出来——他不一样了。
不是难过，不是伤心，是一种更深的、更远的东西。
像是什么都没发生过，又像是所有东西都发生了。
议事结束的时候，李雨田走过来，拍了拍他的肩膀。
“老肖，回去歇歇吧。“
“嗯。“
肖琪回到自己的帐篷，放下帐帘，坐在榻上。
帐里很静。
只有风声从帐外传来，吹得旗帜猎猎作响。
他坐在那里，没有动。
第一天。
他没有出帐。
李雨田来过一次，在帐门外站了很久。
“老肖？“他叫了一声。
帐里没有回应。
“老肖，你吃点东西吧。“
还是没有回应。
李雨田在帐门外站了很久，最后叹了口气，走了。

风云雷闪四兄妹也来过一次。
“将军？“风暴在帐门外叫了一声，“我们……我们给你送了点吃的，放在帐门口了。“
帐里还是没有回应。
四兄妹在帐门外站了很久，互相看了一眼，不知道该说什么。
“走吧。“云彩最后说，“让他一个人待会儿。“
四兄妹走了。
帐门口放着一只碗，碗里是热粥，还冒着热气。
但帐帘一直没有掀开。
第二天。
他还是没有出帐。
池锦英来过一次，在帐门外站了很久。
“将军。“他说，声音很轻，“军中有些事要处理。“
帐里没有回应。
“我知道你现在……“池锦英停了一下，不知道该怎么说，“但军务不能拖。“
还是没有回应。
池锦英在帐门外站了很久，最后叹了口气，走了。
他走的时候，回头看了一眼。
帐帘还是放下的，把里面的人挡在外面。
他不知道肖琪在里面做什么，想什么，但他知道——有些事，只能一个人扛。
李雨田又来过一次。

这次他没有在帐门外站很久，而是直接掀开帐帘，走了进去。
帐里很暗，没有点灯。
肖琪坐在榻上，背对着帐门，一动不动。
content_en:
The day Nangong Yan left, Xiao Qi didn't look back.
He walked into the Chinese army's tent, discussed matters, mobilized troops, and set up defenses, as if nothing had happened.
But everyone could see it - he was different.
It's not sad, it's not sad, it's something deeper and further away.
It's like nothing happened, and like everything happened.
At the end of the discussion, Li Yutian came over and patted him on the shoulder.
"Old Xiao, go back and have a rest."
"Hmm."
Xiao Qi returned to her tent, put down the curtain, and sat on the couch.
The tent was very quiet.
Only the sound of wind came from outside the tent, making the flags flutter.
He sat there, not moving.
Day one.
He did not pay the bill.
Li Yutian came once and stood outside the tent for a long time.
"Lao Xiao?" he called.
There was no response from the account.
"Old Xiao, please have something to eat."
Still no response.
Li Yutian stood outside the tent for a long time, finally sighed and left.
The four brothers and sisters of Fengyun Leishan also came once.
"General?" Storm called outside the tent door, "We...we brought you some food and left it at the tent door."
There was still no response from the account.
The four brothers and sisters stood outside the tent for a long time, looking at each other and not knowing what to say.
"Let's go." Yun Cai finally said, "Leave him alone for a while."
The four brothers and sisters are gone.
There was a bowl placed at the door of the tent. In the bowl was hot porridge, which was still steaming.
But the curtain was never opened.
the next day.
He still hasn't paid.
Chi Jinying came once and stood outside the tent for a long time.
"General." He said, his voice very soft, "There are things to deal with in the army."
There was no response from the account.
"I know you are now..." Chi Jinying paused, not knowing what to say, "but military affairs cannot be delayed."
Still no response.
Chi Jinying stood outside the tent for a long time, finally sighed and left.
As he left, he looked back.
The curtains were still lowered to keep out the people inside.
He didn't know what Xiao Qi was doing or thinking inside, but he knew - some things could only be handled by one person.
Li Yutian came again.
This time he did not stand outside the tent door for a long time, but directly opened the tent curtain and walked in.
The tent was dark, with no lights on.
Xiao Qi sat on the couch, with her back to the tent door, motionless.
